verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS platform with an open-source CLI and MCP server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out in the web app, the Ramp CLI, or the MCP integrations. OAuth scopes, MCP role restrictions and audit logs are access controls, not tracking opt-outs, so they earn no credit.
